summary: The AI video generation landscape in 2026 is dominated by Google's Veo model family, which powers the Flow filmmaking tool and reportedly captures the overwhelming majority of measured video generations. The broader market—spanning text-to-video generation, avatar/business video, and editing workflows—is valued in the billions, with text-to-video being the dominant creation method at ~46% of generations. While OpenAI discontinued its standalone Sora consumer app in April 2026, a competitive field remains, with Runway, Kling, Luma, and Pika leading cinematic and creator-focused generation, and Synthesia and HeyGen dominating enterprise avatar video.

tools.name: Veo (Flow)
tools.pricing_paid: Google AI Pro $19.99/mo; Google AI Ultra $249.99/mo (includes Flow access)
tools.max_length: ~8 seconds per clip (extendable via Flow scene stitching)
strengths: Dominant measured market share of video generations in 2026
Strong cinematic camera and motion control via Flow
Deep integration with Google AI ecosystem and Gemini
tools.best_for: Cinematic text-to-video and AI filmmaking with generated audio

tools.name: Runway
strengths: Comprehensive creative suite with editing tools
Act-One performance capture and keyframe control
tools.best_for: Professional filmmakers needing precise camera and motion control

tools.name: Kling AI
tools.pricing_paid: Credit-based tiers; roughly $10-$92/mo depending on plan
tools.max_length: Up to 15 seconds per generation (Kling v3 Pro)
strengths: Longest clip duration among leaders at published per-second rate
Strong character consistency across multi-shot sequences
tools.best_for: Longer narrative clips needing character consistency on a budget

tools.name: Synthesia
strengths: Leading enterprise AI avatar and presenter video
Strong for training, L&D, and corporate communications
tools.best_for: Enterprise training and corporate avatar-based videos

tools.name: HeyGen
strengths: Realistic voice cloning and lip-sync translation
Fast marketing and sales video production
tools.best_for: Marketing, sales, and localized avatar video at scale

tools.name: Luma Dream Machine
strengths: Creative agent and multi-model production direction
tools.best_for: Creators prioritizing natural motion and fast iteration

tools.name: Pika
strengths: Cheapest entry point for AI video
Fun effects like Pikaffects and Pikaframes
tools.best_for: Short-form creative and social video experimentation

tools.name: Adobe Firefly Video
tools.pricing_paid: Firefly plan from ~$9.99/mo; included in Creative Cloud tiers
strengths: Deep integration with Premiere Pro and Creative Cloud
tools.best_for: Adobe creative pros needing commercially safe generation in existing workflows

tools.name: Descript
strengths: AI voice cloning (Overdub) and eye contact correction
Strong for podcasts and talking-head content
tools.best_for: Podcast and talking-head editing with AI assistance

tools.name: Hailuo AI
strengths: Exceptional prompt adherence and cinematic motion
Rapid model iteration and growing global adoption
tools.best_for: High-quality cinematic text-to-video on a budget

tools.name: Haiper AI
tools.best_for: Hobbyists and creators testing text/image-to-video for free
